name: The Roommate
source:
Some time after the collapse of society, you find yourself expelled from the relative safety of your mountain home.

Forced into the ruins of the old world, your salvation comes in the form of the beautiful and enigmatic Kari.

As you settle into your new life, you discover that much of what you were told growing up was untrue and you find yourself with more questions than answers.
translation:
在社会崩溃一段时间后，你被逐出了原本相对安全的山中家园。

被迫踏入旧世界废墟的你，因美丽而神秘的卡莉而得救。

随着你在新生活中安顿下来，你发现从小被灌输的许多事情都并非事实，心中的疑问也远远多于答案。
